bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing literature on mitigation strategies that integrate social awareness into LLMs, specifically examining methods like Perspective-taking Prompting (PeT) and Social Contact Debiasing (SCD) which measure and reduce stereotypes across various demographic dimensions.

Summarizing evaluations from benchmarks like NormAd that assess large language models' ability to interpret and adhere to culturally specific social expectations, particularly comparing performance differences between well-represented regions and underrepresented regions like the Global South.
